previous_description: Aggregated coverage status across all targets and requirements within a test coverage model, suitable for test summary reporting.
definition: A model-wide test summary report record that totals the coverage targets, coverage requirements and test case sketches of exactly one TestCoverageModel at a point in time. Per-target figures are rolled up from the model's TargetCoverageSummary records.

distinguish_from.when: the metrics (sketch, implemented and automated counts or a percentage) describe a single TestCoverageTarget rather than the whole model.
the artifact records one specific shortfall between required and achieved coverage, with a severity and a remediation status, rather than aggregate totals.
the artifact is the coverage specification itself, holding the targets, partitions and requirements, rather than a generated report about it.
the artifact is an approved decision to leave a target or requirement uncovered, rather than a count of what is covered.

standard_reference: IEEE 829-2008 Master Test Report / Level Test Report (overview and summary of results; the Test Summary Report in IEEE 829-1998)
code_evidence: A script or CI job that loads the test coverage model (YAML or JSON) and emits totals of targets, requirements and test cases with a generation timestamp.
A generated report artifact (e.g. coverage-model-summary.json or a Markdown table in docs/testing) that lists overall counts per model and links to per-target summaries.
A test-reporting dashboard or README section that publishes model-level totals of covered features, requirements and designed test cases for a named application.

attribute_descriptions.name: generatedAt
attribute_descriptions.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which the summary was computed; set it every time the summary is regenerated so stale reports can be detected.

attribute_descriptions.name: totalTargets
attribute_descriptions.description: Non-negative count of TestCoverageTarget nodes in the referenced model at generation time, including targets that have exclusions or gaps.

attribute_descriptions.name: totalRequirements
attribute_descriptions.description: Non-negative count of CoverageRequirement nodes across all targets in the referenced model at generation time.

attribute_descriptions.name: totalSketches
attribute_descriptions.description: Non-negative count of TestCaseSketch nodes across all targets in the model regardless of status; this equals the sum of sketchCount over the model's TargetCoverageSummary records.

notes: Holds only design-time inventory counts, with no achieved-coverage metrics (implemented, automated, percentage, open gaps or exclusions), so it cannot summarise coverage status as defined. Line or branch coverage outputs such as istanbul coverage-summary.json do not map to it. modelRef is optional despite the composes relationship. The aggregates, references and serves edges to testcoveragemodel are redundant.
